en.html:
I pulled the nearly broken armoured wings upright and flew. The enemy was trying to recover also.

Could I finish it before then?

No. It did not matter if I was too late.

Before or after—so long as I killed it!

Kageaki"Good."

I cut Muramasa off in the middle of what would probably have been a warning.

The necessary part I had heard.

Only execution remained!
